Party Table Seating

Enter each table's seats and whether it is step-free, then each party's size and fixed table; choose “Seat parties” to get a seating plan that never splits a party.

Tables

Up to 4 tables. Each table needs a name and a seat count; seats 1–20.

Parties

Up to 8 parties. Each party needs a name and a size; size 1–20. A party is never split. Tick “Needs step-free” when the party can only sit at a step-free table; “Fixed table” may stay empty.

The sample is fixed placeholder data that demonstrates backtracking; after loading, choose “Seat parties” to calculate.
